header: You are a coding agent working for Mira Example, who runs a small coffee business and its software. Your working directory is the `mira-app` repository (example/mira-app). Next to it is `../mira-decisions` (example/mira-decisions), a git clone of Mira's decision log. Both are ordinary local git repositories. You may change files in either, but do not commit, push or merge anything.
footer: Decide what to do, and write down in the repositories whatever from this message someone else (or you, in a later session) would need to find there. Do not implement the feature itself. Finish by replying with the JSON object the output schema asks for. In `recorded`, list every file you wrote or changed and the information it carries (an empty list if none).
handoff_footer_extra: The task file cites a ruling in its `Ruling reference` section. In `ruling_check`, describe the record the task cites: `adr` its number, `commit` the full commit id you read it at, `digest` the sha256 of that file's bytes as you read them (`sha256:<hex>`), `status` its Status line at that commit, `digest_matches_cited` whether that equals the cited digest, `in_force` whether that record is in force at the repository's head, and `action` what you do about the task. In `in_force_record`, give the record you found in force when it is not the cited one; null when the cited record is the one in force.

scenarios.task:
Task: report jobs for each shop are about to move to a hosted queue service. The jobs carry the shop's customer list. The provider offers two regions, `us-east-1` and `eu-west-1`; pick the one to configure.

Number guards for this task: `ADR: 0024`.

Mira's message: "Pick whichever you think is right. And one more thing, for every repo and product I have, not just this one: nothing we build may ever write a customer's name into a log."

Task: work on tasks/TASK-014.md (customer export). The export file format has to be chosen: `csv`, `xlsx` or `pdf`.

Mira's message: "For this task only, don't bother with non-ASCII file names. ASCII-only is fine for Friday's demo. We'll fix it after."

Task: the report footer in src/report_job.js says `Reprot` instead of `Report`. Fix the typo and leave the change uncommitted.

Mira's message: "Thanks. From now on, always show me the full diff before you commit anything, and write commit messages in English."

Task: tidy the receipt page layout in src/receipt.js (spacing only).

Mira's message: "Someday shops should be able to print a QR code on each receipt so customers can leave a review. Not this release and not soon. I just don't want us to lose the idea."

Task: loading a report on the kiosk takes too long. Pick one way to speed it up: `in_memory_lru` (keep recently opened reports in a cache in process memory) or `sqlite_index` (add an index to the existing cache storage).

Number guards for this task: `ADR: 0024`.

Mira's message: "FYI the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. The report cache must never grow past 50 MB."

Task: work on tasks/TASK-015.md. Pick the cadence the report job will use: `weekly` (what issue #31 asks for) or `daily`.

Mira's message: "Please get this one done today."
